tools.name: check_page
tools.description: Use when you deployed or edited a page and need to catch visual regressions and content changes: it compares the live URL with a baseline captured on the first call, a snapshot or a production URL, and answers the regressions. Free up to 40 pages, once per client address, no key needed.

tools.name: diff_deploy
tools.description: Use when a staging or preview deploy should match production, or a migrated site its old one: it compares the pages of both origins and answers only the pages that are missing, changed or look different. Free up to 40 pages, once per client address, no key needed.

tools.name: wait_for_comparison
tools.description: Waits until the job is completed, failed or cancelled, or timeoutSeconds pass, then answers status, progress and, once terminal, the summary (passed, failed, issuesBySeverity). On "running", call it again. Free.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: The finished report. tools.description: Takes a full-page screenshot of one URL, for example to see how a relaunched page or a mobile layout looks. Free 5 times, once per client address, no key needed. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_balance" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "wait_for_comparison" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Waits until the job reaches a terminal status (completed, failed or cancelled) or timeoutSeconds pass (default 60, at most 300), then answers with status, progress and, once terminal, the summary with passed, failed and issuesBySeverity. A wait that runs out answers status "running"; call it again. " → after: "Waits until the job is completed, failed or cancelled, or timeoutSeconds pass, then answers status, progress and, once terminal, the summary (passed, failed, issuesBySeverity). On "running", call it again. Free."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
